priorityList: Maintain Agony and Corruption. If there are 3+ targets stacked together, use Seed to apply and maintain Corruption.
Cast Haunt whenever available on the primary target.
Cast Seed if already at 5 Soul Shards to avoid capping.
Cast Seed if above 2 shards before Dark Harvest comes off cooldown.
Cast Dark Harvest whenever available with any periodic effect such as Corruption, Agony or Unstable Affliction active on every target.
Cast Drain Soul as a filler.
